"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today, America must unite to help the most vulnerable residents get back on their feet.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today, America must unite to restore the vitality of both urban centers and family farms.",
